title: fix(objectql): file-field hydration asks canReadObject before reading sys_file, so a record read logs no access denial
body:
Fixes #24335

Clause-②: no (no accept set or public surface moves: the served bodies and every refusal are unchanged; owes the seat's review of record at `TIER_DEFAULT` before the queue)

## What changed

`resolveFileReferences` (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`) read `sys_file` as the caller and took the refused arm on the throw. A member with read on the record's object and without `sys_file` read therefore made a `sys_file` access attempt on every by-id and list read, and plugin-security logged `[Security] Access denied: operation 'find' on object 'sys_file' is not permitted for positions [org_member, everyone]` at WARN for each one.

The engine now **asks before it reads**, as the parent-record read gate does ("A skipped object is not an access attempt", `parent-record-read-gate.ts`):

- New private `callerMayReadSysFile` asks the registered security service's `canReadObject('sys_file', caller)`. It goes through the slot the engine already resolves (`resolveReadableIdsSecurity`, wired by `ObjectQLPlugin`) and uses the caller's envelope minus its operation-private keys (`withoutOperationPrivateKeys`, as `readParentDerivedFiles` already does). No new security API.
- `false`: the refused arm is served without the read.
- `true`: the caller's read goes ahead exactly as before, and the middleware still decides.
- Unasked (no usable security service, no `canReadObject`, or an ask that throws): the read goes to the middleware as before. The ask can only narrow what is read.
- The refused arm moves verbatim into `serveRefusedFileHydration`. It is shared by the ask and by the existing `PERMISSION_DENIED` catch, which stays for any refusal the admission did not foresee.
- ⛔ `plugin-security` is not touched: its refusal, its log line and its level are unchanged.

## Why this shape (four axes)

- **Real business need:** measured. Every member of a deployment whose app grants no `sys_file` read hits this on every record read (the WARN reproduced below on the booted composition).
- **Long-term soundness:** engine-only. The security layer stays the single judge of every read it sees, and `canReadObject` is its own object-level gate, arm for arm. The alternative, a context flag marking the hydration read internal, would cross into `plugin-security` (`domain:services`) and add a bypass marker.
- **Guarding against AI mistakes:** no bypass marker means there is nothing an author or agent can set to mute a denial. The refused value contract (`FileRefusedValueSchema`) is unchanged.
- **Startup scope:** no new API, option, error code or gate.

## Measurements (M, booted composition)

New dogfood pin `packages/qa/dogfood/test/file-field-hydration-no-denial.dogfood.test.ts`. It runs on a real org-bound `bootStack` with the real `SecurityPlugin`, the real `StorageServicePlugin` (local adapter, real bytes), and one record object holding a field-owned file. "Before" is measured on the same boot with `canReadObject` withdrawn from the service, which is the engine's pre-change path.

| read | reader | before: security denials | after: security denials | body |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /data/fhn_doc/ID` | member, no `sys_file` read | 1 (`on object 'sys_file'`) | **0** | byte-identical (`res.text()`), file hydrated |
| `GET /data/fhn_doc` | member, no `sys_file` read | 1 | **0** | byte-identical, file hydrated |
| `GET /data/fhn_doc/ID` and list | reader with `sys_file` read | 0 | 0 | byte-identical, same hydrated value |
| `GET /data/sys_file/ID` | member | - | 1 | `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, unchanged |

Run on `df035c834`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/file-field-hydration-no-denial.dogfood.test.ts`, 5 passed.

**Ablation (one, of the ask):** done with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit once, blob `0186fa3c` → `b21c19e7`). The ask was disabled, objectql was rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 4 `dist/` files. The two member WARN-count pins went red with exactly the issue's line: `expected [ "[Security] Access denied: operation 'find' on object 'sys_file' is not permitted for positions [org_member, everyone]" ] to deeply equal []` (2 failed, 3 passed). Restore: blob back to `0186fa3c`, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, `--absent` preflight clean, 5 passed.

**Cost of the ask:** one `canReadObject` per hydration call, which is once per request for both by-id and list (measured: 1 ask per by-id read, 1 per list read), never per row. It is a cached permission check with no store read: 6.4 µs per ask (mean of 300 iterations on a shared box). The refused `sys_file` read it replaces cost about 1.2 ms. A reader with `sys_file` read pays the extra ask. End-to-end by-id latency on the shared box was within noise.

## Pins beside it

`packages/objectql/src/engine-file-hydrate-refused.test.ts` reuses that file's existing driver double, so no new double is added. Its `boot` gains a `security` slot option and an attempts log on the refusing middleware. New cases:

- A refused admission makes no `sys_file` read and serves the refused marker. The ask is about `sys_file`, carries the caller's envelope and no `__` keys.
- The list and by-id bodies are byte-identical to the unasked engine's, and that comparison is armed: the unasked engine did attempt the read.
- A direct `sys_file` read is still `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403 and still reaches the security layer.
- Controls: an admitted reader is hydrated; an admitted read that is still refused takes the same arm; with no `canReadObject`, or an ask that throws, the engine reads as before; a record with no file id asks nothing.

Pin sweep: the existing pins on the refused arm and its `debug` line (`engine-file-hydrate-refused.test.ts`, `engine-file-hydrate-parent-derived.test.ts`, plugin-security `file-field-hydration-refused.test.ts`, service-storage `field-owned-file-hydration-door-agreement.test.ts`) wire no security service into the slot, so they still exercise the read-then-refuse arm, and they stay green unmodified.

## Verification record (head `df035c834`, after merging `origin/main` `e22defb13`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`: exit 0. Both were run before and after the merge.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run`: 445 files, 8366 tests passed.
- Dogfood pin: 5 passed (after the merge, on rebuilt `objectql`, `plugin-auth` and `platform-objects`).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths), 74 families. All 72 runnable families exit 0 on `df035c834`. `--ran` reconciliation: `74 derived, 72 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
  - NOT MEASURED: `check:query-options-erasure` (repo-wide eslint scan). The first local attempt was in flight when the container killed the worker (exit 137), and the retry hit the 280 s local window. CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.
  - NOT MEASURED: `check:type-check-debt` (repo-wide tsc census). It hit the same window and is left to CI.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: 8 unbuilt packages). It was built for and re-run, and passes: 111 require entry points load.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: OK, 0 lost.

## Acceptance notes

- `canReadObject` mirrors the middleware's object-level arms but not its public-form grant (`publicFormGrant`), which admits `find` only on the form's own target object. A form targeting `sys_file` is not a realistic declaration, so no such caller reaches this path. Noted, not filed.
- Locally, an interrupted gate run left `packages/spec/dist` without its `.d.ts`, and a spec rebuild restored it. This was local build state, not a finding.
- The dogfood pin is declared to `domain:cli` at review, per the claim.
